verdict.rationale: GitLab's technology-partner directory lists a Zulip integration that delivers GitLab project notifications to a chat tool. It also lists a Slack integration for interacting with GitLab from a Slack workspace. Both are thin directory blurbs, and the Slack entry doesn't explicitly describe repository or merge-request notifications. Missing for 10: first-party docs for configuring repo/MR notification events to Slack, explicit Discord support, explicit Microsoft Teams support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send repository and pull request notifications to chat tools like Slack, Discord, or Microsoft Teams

citations.quote: Get notifications about your GitLab projects in Zulip.
Interact with GitLab without leaving your Slack workspace!
